results.title: Associate, Recruiter
results.description: Quantam is looking to hire an enthusiastic and hardworking Recruiting Associate to assist with our recruiting activities. This is an entry-level position and you will be responsible for posting job applications online, examining résumés, screening potential candidates, and the submission of candidates. To ensure success as a Recruiting Associate, you should have excellent communication skills, and the ability to multi-task. A top-notch Recruiting Associate understands the needs of the company and ensures that only qualified candidates make it through to the final interview. About QuantamQuantam is an information technology consulting firm specializing in government technology modernization. Headquartered in Metro-Detroit Michigan and operating all throughout the United States. Our team is made up of doers, go-getters and those who think outside the box. We know the demands of the job can be great at times and that is why we offer our team members unparallel benefits with an environment to flourish. Quantam is growing at record pace, and we have no intentions of stopping. Recruiting Associate Responsibilities:Reviewing available positions and candidate requirementsCommunicating with the corporate teamPosting job applications on social media and job sitesSourcing potential candidatesScreening candidate résumésAssisting with résumé conversions Contacting candidate references and verifying education requirementsConducting screeningsConducting interview prep sessionsSubmitting candidates Communicating with candidates and setting up interviewsManaging the résumé databaseMaintaining relationships with candidates Recruiting Associate Requirements:Associate degree in computer science, human resources, business, communications, or similar fieldExcellent verbal and written communication skillsAdvanced interpersonal skillsCritical thinking skillsAbility to conduct interviews over the phone and webcamExcellent decision-making skillsGood organizational skills

results.title: Technical Recruiting Specialist
results.description: IT Recruiting Specialist We are currently seeking a tech-savvy dedicated and detail-oriented professional to join our team as an IT Recruiting Specialist. In this role, you will be responsible for leveraging your technology oriented interests combined with business acumen and recruitment expertise to support our company's growth in the dynamic and competitive technology sector. Responsibilities: Tech Talent Acquisition: Partner with hiring managers to solicit technical requirements, design and execute targeted recruitment strategies, and deliver expected results within established SLAs. Source, assess, and recruit top-notch technology professionals through various channels, including online platforms, networking events, and industry partnerships. Business Liaison: Act as a technical liaison between the business units and the recruitment team, ensuring a thorough understanding of technology needs and priorities. Collaborate with department heads to align recruitment efforts with overall business goals. Candidate Engagement: Engage with the tech community and technology ecosystems to cultivate potential candidates, providing them with a comprehensive understanding of our company's culture, values, and career opportunities. Conduct technical interviews and assessments to evaluate candidates' technical skills and cultural fit within the organization. Process Optimization: Continuously review and optimize recruitment processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Provide recommendations for improvements based on industry and technology best practices and feedback from internal stakeholders. Data Management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in our applicant tracking system (ATS). Generate and analyze recruitment metrics to track the success of sourcing strategies and make data-driven recommendations. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Human Resources, or a related field. Proven experience in business operations or recruitment, with a focus on technology roles. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse stakeholders. Familiarity with recruitment tools and technology platforms. Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for technology recruitment and business optimization, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity to contribute to our company's success. AW

results.title: Search Associate

If you are looking for a long-term career and not just your next job, apply now! results.title: Staffing Recruiter
results.description: Job Title: Staffing Coordinator RecruiterSummary: We are seeking a staffing recruiter for our office on the north side of Holland. The recruiter is responsible for the full cycling of recruitment. That includes sourcing candidates, Interviewing, placement, keeping in contact with employees, and communicating with our client companies on a daily basis. Responsibilities:- Contribute positive mindset atmosphere.- Post Job Ads to social media and websites.- Sourcing candidates that have shown interest in job postings: Call, Email, Text.- Screening and Interviewing Candidates: Phone screens are conducted, then candidates are scheduled to come into the office for an interview. - Onboarding new employees into our applicant tracking system. - Coordinating Interviews, start dates, as well as terminations when necessary. - Presenting candidates to clients over email and phone. - Act as point of contact between clients and employees. Skills:- Must enjoy working with people. - Teachable and coachable- Excellent written and verbal communication. - Ability to adapt to new systems and processes. - Comfortable with computers; strong abilities in Windows Suite: Outlook, Word, Excel.- Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize multiple ongoing projects.Schedule:- 40 Hours/Week- 8 Hour Shift- Monday-FridayBenefits:- Paid Time Off- Health Insurance- Dental Insurance- Vision Insurance If you’re interested in learning more about this position, please reply to this post with your resume and we'll follow up with you. Thank you!

results.title: Recruiter
results.description: Details –This person will be doing full cycle recruiting for direct labor positions, primarily machinists. Recruiter will be responsible for screening resumes, call candidates, do brief initial phone screens, schedule interviews, participate in interviews, be the primary focal point for candidates and keep in touch with them as they move through the process. Recruiter may extend offers and coordinate pre-employment steps.Looking for someone very detailed and able to keep things rolling. Need to be professional, well-spoken and comfortable calling candidates.Very high-volume recruiting. Will be working on 40 direct labor roles that need to be filled quickly. Key Responsibilities:- Manage the full recruitment cycle including posting job ads, screening resumes, contacting applicants, conducting phone and in-person interviews, and coordinating hiring efforts with department managers.- Act as the focal point for all candidates throughout the recruitment process, responding quickly to questions from candidates- Coordinate pre-employment steps with candidates such as pre-employment drug screens and background checks through our third-party vendors- Provide regular updates and reports to HR team and leadership on recruitment status.- Update and maintain the applicant flow log with candidate status- Maintain accurate and up-to-date recruitment records using our HRIS system. Qualifications:- High School diploma required, BS degree in HR or a related field preferred.- Proven experience in recruitment, specifically in manufacturing or a similar industrial setting.- Strong understanding of recruitment processes and candidate selection methods.- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to engage effectively with candidates and internal stakeholders.- Proficiency in using HR software and candidate databases.- Ability to handle multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Education –High school or equivalent
